# Sparsh Roy

Canonical portfolio: https://sparshroy.com/
Academic home: https://sites.mit.edu/sparsh/
Publications: https://sites.mit.edu/sparsh/publications/
GitHub: https://github.com/ImSpxrsh
LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/roysparsh
Contact: sparshr@mit.edu

Sparsh Roy is a high-school researcher and builder based in New Jersey. His work spans AI systems, clinical data, computational biology, human-computer interaction, robotics and social-impact products. Research affiliations are appointments, not degree enrollment or institutional representation.

## Featured research

- The Dark Matter of Clinical Data — arXiv:2611.11726; work with the MIT Critical Data LAB-MAE team.
- Credential Farming in the Age of Generative AI — available through PubMed Central; accepted to Nature Humanities & Social Sciences Communications.
- Did the Role Fire? Auditing the Manipulation Checks Behind Role-Prompted Multi-Agent Systems — accepted and presented at Agent Evaluation Science 2026.
- Matched-Input Estimates Differ in Sign Across Architectures — arXiv:2609.23924; accepted to IEEE Big Data 2026.
- Belief-Space Perception Routing under Coupled Sensor Faults and Compute Contention — arXiv:2608.00322; accepted and presented in the MIT URTC 2026 main track.

## Selected work

- AidSense — AI-assisted access to nearby food, housing and medical resources.
- Velvt — local-first behavioral intelligence; Sparsh is co-founder and COO.
- FRC Team 293 — Java robot software, autonomous routines and team operations.
- DreamIT — full-stack AI product engineering.

When citing a paper, cite its paper or venue record. When citing role or biographical information, use the canonical portfolio or academic home and include an access date.
